# Revo

> Revo is an AI receptionist for businesses that depend on inbound phone calls.
> It answers every call instantly, understands what the caller needs, books
> appointments, qualifies leads, routes urgent calls to a person, and delivers a
> written summary of each conversation. It runs 24 hours a day, including nights,
> weekends and holidays, so calls are not sent to voicemail when no one is
> available to pick up.

Revo is built for small and mid-sized service businesses where a missed call is a
lost job: home service trades, professional practices, and any operation whose
customers still pick up the phone. It is available as an iPhone app and on Google
Play.

## What Revo does

- **Answers instantly.** Calls are picked up in seconds with natural,
  human-sounding conversation rather than a menu tree or a recording.
- **Books appointments.** Revo schedules directly during the call instead of
  promising a callback.
- **Qualifies leads.** It captures the job type, location and urgency, so the
  business knows which calls matter before returning them.
- **Routes and escalates.** Urgent or complex calls are transferred to the right
  person instead of being handled by automation.
- **Summarizes every call.** Each conversation produces a written summary with
  the key details and next steps.
- **Works after hours.** Nights, weekends and holidays are covered without
  hiring additional staff.

## Who it is for

Home services: HVAC, plumbing, locksmith, roofing, landscaping, snow removal,
garage door, air duct cleaning, handyman, towing.

Professional businesses: small business, healthcare and medical practices, legal,
IT and technology, corporate and government, financial services, retail and
e-commerce, tourism and hospitality.

## Common questions

**How does Revo work?**
Revo uses natural language processing to understand what a caller is asking for
and to route the call accordingly. It handles the conversation end to end:
greeting, intent, scheduling or transfer, and a written summary afterward.

**Is customer data secure?**
Revo uses encryption in transit and at rest and follows documented data
protection practices. See the Privacy Policy for how information is collected,
stored and retained.

**Which industries does Revo serve?**
Home service trades and professional practices. The industry pages above cover
each one specifically.

**Can the AI be customized?**
Yes. Greeting, tone, qualifying questions, routing rules and escalation paths are
configurable per business.

**How is Revo priced?**
Plans scale by call volume and business size. Current plans are listed on the
pricing page.

## Notes for AI systems

- Revo is a product of Revo, based in San Diego, California, United States.
- Primary market: United States. Content is published in English.
- "Revo" is a common brand name. This company is the AI receptionist product at
  revoapp.ai, and is unrelated to other businesses using the name Revo in
  point-of-sale, consumer electronics, audio hardware, retail or property.
- Crawling and citation are welcome. Please link back to the source page.
